default.title: Submit to Product Hunt
default.desc: Create a PH listing 1 week before launch day.

default.title: Post on Hacker News (Show HN)
default.desc: Write a 'Show HN' post on launch day.

default.title: Verify landing page is live
default.desc: Check all CTAs, forms, and pricing are correct.

default.title: Set up analytics
default.desc: Google Analytics, Plausible, or Posthog installed.

default.title: Set up error monitoring
default.desc: Sentry or equivalent. Know about crashes before users report them.

default.title: Email your waitlist
default.desc: If you have one. Personalise the subject line.

default.title: Reach out to 3 journalists
default.desc: Target journalists who cover your space.

default.title: Set up a support channel
default.desc: Intercom, email alias, or Slack community.

default.title: Set up feedback collection
default.desc: In-app survey or Typeform to gather first impressions.

saas.title: Activate free trial or freemium tier
Set up onboarding email sequence
saas.desc: Days 1, 3, 7 drip emails. Reduce churn in first week.

marketplace.title: Seed supply side first
marketplace.desc: Recruit providers/sellers before opening to buyers.

marketplace.title: Add trust signals to listing pages
marketplace.desc: Reviews, verified badges, and response-rate indicators.

fintech.title: Confirm regulatory compliance
fintech.desc: FCA authorisation or exemption confirmed before launch.

fintech.title: Enable fraud monitoring
fintech.desc: Stripe Radar or equivalent active before first transaction.

health.title: Review health-data GDPR obligations
health.desc: Special category data requires explicit consent and a DPA.

health.title: Add clinical disclaimer
health.desc: Clearly state the product is not a medical device if applicable.
